family.name: Form Based Zones final parts
family.issuing_body: City of Albuquerque; the files are City-hosted zoning-code deliveries associated with City Council Form Based Zones proposals.
family.exact_context: The April 2, 2009 final (G3b) delivery of former Zoning Code Section 14-16-3-22 Form Based Zones, replacing the February 27, 2009 G3a revision. G3b is three lettered parts: A, B, and C. The 2017 Integrated Development Ordinance replaced Chapter 14 Article 16, so this is obsolete pre-IDO material.
family.complete_canonical_record: No combined final City document was found. The City collection listing exposes final Part B, while saved server research located final Parts A and C. The related bills O-07-116 and O-08-58 have blank enactment numbers; no enacted ordinance or stronger codified record was established in the bounded saved research.
